name: application-plan-comparison-row
title: Plan Comparison Row
description: Fixed talk/text/data/price columns for comparing telecom plans, with the current plan highlighted — distinct from feature-comparison-matrix, which takes an arbitrary set of feature rows across any number of plans rather than a fixed telecom-specific column shape.
useWhen: Letting a user compare mobile carrier plans by talk/text/data allowance and price.
The current plan should be visually distinguished from alternatives.
Plan attributes are consistently talk/text/data/price rather than an arbitrary feature set.
avoidWhen: You need an arbitrary set of feature rows across plans (not talk/text/data) — use feature-comparison-matrix instead.
You're showing data usage against a single plan's quota — use data-usage-ring instead.
There's only one plan to display — a simple stat row is sufficient.
responsiveBehavior: Columns use a fixed grid-template-columns ratio; on very narrow viewports the consuming page should wrap this in a horizontally scrollable container.
accessibility: The current plan is marked with both a highlighted background and explicit '(current)' text, not color alone.
Column headers label each value (Talk/Text/Data/Price) so screen reader users understand cell meaning without visual alignment.
Price always includes the '/mo' unit rather than a bare number.

variants.title: Plan comparison row
variants.description: Three telecom plans (Basic, Plus, Unlimited) with the Plus plan marked as current, on a light surface.
accessibility: Exactly one plan is marked isSelected, matching real single-plan-at-a-time semantics.

variants.title: Plan comparison row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-plan comparison, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected-row highlight and text colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
